project.name: Worth Touched Graph Milestone 16 Cross Family Parity Proof Residue Collapse And 7.5 Readiness

phases.title: Cross-Family Coverage Inventory Cut Line
acceptance: the coverage inventory contains at least one ordinary-path row for every milestone-16 family kind
coverage rows name source path, owner crate, replacement lane, selected identity fields consumed, Query surface kind, and ordinary-path reachability
the inventory replaces vague mixed-helper language with exact module or folder paths
phases.instructions: Start by refreshing the coding-guideline docs, the touched-graph roadmap, the milestone-16 spec, and forge-query AI_README context, then freeze the live cross-family coverage inventory from real production surfaces.
phases.qa_focus: No grouped-family theater, no grep-only inventory, and no unowned ordinary-path surfaces hidden behind public closeout language.

phases.title: Shared Parity And Readiness Contract Vocabulary
acceptance: shared contracts distinguish declare-once parity, selected-route parity, public-projection parity, and readiness parity
family contributors compile against one shared parity vocabulary rather than crate-local row types
readiness inputs cannot be fabricated from helper-assembled strings or digests
phases.instructions: Land one shared parity and readiness contract lane before any family contributor or readiness proof is implemented.
phases.qa_focus: No generic closeout row bags and no disguised public facade exported as readiness vocabulary.

phases.title: Live Coverage Ledger And Architecture Claim Derivation
acceptance: architecture-claim rows are mechanically derived from live family contributors
rows carry selected-route, seed, architecture-claim, and residue or firewall digests where applicable
closeout counts and residue counts derive from the live ledger rather than prose
phases.instructions: Build the live coverage ledger and architecture-claim derivation lane from Milestone 15 proof products and named contributor APIs.
phases.qa_focus: No docs-only ledger and no production truth derived from tests.

phases.title: Representative Selected-Route Parity Path
acceptance: one named current-path builder carries selected route, family, product, witness, Query posture, residue, and firewall identities end to end
the representative path includes query-backed read, evidence, replay or conflict, reuse, and public-proof or diagnostic consumers
the path rejects local helper reassembly
phases.instructions: Prove one real representative path from touched authority through public proof using a named builder in the new representative_path lane.
phases.qa_focus: No synthetic test-only path and no result-only parity claims.

phases.title: Registered Read, Validator, And Invalidation Family Parity
acceptance: read, validator or invariant, and invalidation families each have explicit contributor catalog rows
one representative declaration applies to multiple matching operators or stages without editing them
operator-local routing language is gone or explicitly blocked
phases.instructions: Certify topology read, validator or invariant, and invalidation families as declare-once contributors to the shared architecture.
phases.qa_focus: No entity-only fallback and no operator-local declarations under new helper names.

phases.title: Evidence Lookup And Retained Spatial Family Parity
acceptance: spatial contributor catalogs name exact route packet, public-closeout digest, support posture, and consumer-residue inputs
Query support posture and consumer residue stay distinct from Worth-local residue
spatial parity rejects local Query-gap fabrication
phases.instructions: Certify evidence lookup and retained spatial families as real contributors to the shared architecture while consuming real Query-owned support surfaces.
phases.qa_focus: No spatial-local Query language and no flattening of Query blockers into generic local debt.

phases.title: Replay And Undo Family Parity
acceptance: replay and undo contributors lower through carried scope and witness contracts
explicit replay or undo contributor catalog rows name the exact packets or identities used for parity proof
parity fails when replay or undo identities diverge even if outputs match
phases.instructions: Certify replay and undo as carried-proof semantic-graph families rather than local scope-reconstruction helpers.
phases.qa_focus: No scope reconstruction folklore and no denial-witness collapse into strings.

phases.title: Conflict, Independence, And Batch-Admission Family Parity
acceptance: conflict, independence, and batch-admission contributors lower through carried overlap, plan, and witness contracts
an explicit conflict-family contributor catalog names the exact packets or identities used for parity proof
batch-admission remains a pre-execution selected-plan family
phases.instructions: Certify the Milestone 13 concurrency families as one aspect-routed architecture rather than parallel policy subsystems.
phases.qa_focus: No executor-success theater and no local conflict categories hiding inside diagnostics.

phases.title: Compiled-Product Equivalence And Reuse Family Parity
acceptance: reuse contributors lower through explicit equivalence, compatibility, and witness contracts
an explicit reuse-family contributor catalog names the exact packets or identities used for parity proof
parity fails when reuse basis, equivalence policy, or denial identity diverges even if outputs match
phases.instructions: Certify compiled-product equivalence and reuse as explicit semantic claims rather than performance folklore.
phases.qa_focus: No rendered-output sameness and no compatibility silently promoted into reuse.

phases.title: Public Proof And Derived Diagnostic Parity
acceptance: public proof and diagnostics expose matching selected-route, family, product, and witness identities for the same representative path
projections fail on mismatched selected-route, seed, residue, or firewall digests
public proof and diagnostics remain derived parity consumers rather than alternate family declarers
phases.instructions: Certify public proof and derived diagnostics as downstream projections of the same carried route authority used by the family contributors.
phases.qa_focus: No projection authority drift and no pretty-output closeout without identity agreement.

phases.title: Milestone 7.5 Readiness Handoff Contract
acceptance: one typed readiness artifact carries touched or overlap identities, selected-route identities, representative family coverage, Query posture evidence, residue and firewall digests, and the architecture-claim digest
one concrete downstream 7.5-style consumer accepts only the readiness artifact and fails if required parity fields are missing
the handoff is not a bundle of separately reassembled report values
phases.instructions: Emit one typed handoff proving Milestone 7.5 can start from touched authority and planner-owned proof without reviving local overlap or diagnostic rules.
phases.qa_focus: No prose checklist handoff and no downstream rediscovery from topology or conflict helpers.

phases.title: Final Ordinary-Authority Closeout Lane Cutover
acceptance: new closeout lanes exist on disk before displaced lane surgery
displaced ordinary-authority helper lanes stop owning live architecture claims
Phase 1 names the exact displaced lanes this phase cuts over
phases.instructions: Create the final parallel closeout lanes and cut any remaining mixed ordinary-authority folders off the unified architecture.
phases.qa_focus: No in-place final cleanup and no legacy helper wrapped with a parity facade and still left authoritative.

phases.title: Compatibility, Adapter, And Report Hard Deletion Or Residue Cap
acceptance: every remaining compatibility, adapter, or report lane is either deleted or explicitly present in the residue ledger
residual report helpers cannot serve as ordinary-path sources for parity, readiness, or public projection claims
surviving lanes are already unreachable from the ordinary path
phases.instructions: Delete or explicitly cap the remaining compatibility, adapter, and report lanes that no longer own ordinary architecture truth after cutover.
phases.qa_focus: No tiny-folder exemptions and no hidden architecture authority left in report helpers.

phases.title: Reintroduction Firewalls And Compile-Fail Denials
acceptance: compile-fail fixtures reject imports of displaced local routing, overlap, reuse, or closeout helpers on covered paths
parity and readiness inputs cannot be fabricated from raw parts
firewalls guard route rediscovery, overlap reconstruction, reuse-basis fabrication, and raw public proof or readiness constructors
phases.instructions: Seal the finished architecture so the old family-local languages cannot quietly return.
phases.qa_focus: No review-discipline-only preservation and no raw constructors left public just for tests.

phases.title: Exact Residue Collapse And Honest Query-Gap Classification
acceptance: every surviving row is derived from live code surfaces with explicit owner, blocker, and removal trigger
Query-gap rows classify one exact blocker shape: missing, not admitted, not exposed, or identity semantics insufficient
later-scope blocker rows are mechanically unreachable from the covered ordinary path
phases.instructions: Collapse every remaining disagreement with the unified architecture into exact typed residue or exact upstream blocker classification.
phases.qa_focus: No vague future-work buckets and no generic Query-gap theology.

phases.title: Cross-Family Closeout Matrix And Certified Counts
acceptance: the final matrix publishes the required certification columns for coverage, parity, readiness, and residue counts
matrix counts match live derived coverage and residue ledgers exactly
uncertified family kinds fail closeout
phases.instructions: Emit the final matrix proving the roadmapâ€™s declared family coverage, residue counts, and architecture claims match live implementation state.
phases.qa_focus: No hand-maintained matrix and no approximate counts.

phases.title: Final Closeout And Roadmap Completion Gate
acceptance: the final gate fails unless covered family kinds, representative path, readiness handoff, and residue collapse all certify the same architecture claim
the final gate fails if any covered ordinary path still depends on a second ontology
the roadmap closes only when the next system can extend the kernel by declaration rather than reopening covered family logic
phases.instructions: Close the touched graph roadmap only when the parity proof, readiness handoff, residue collapse, and reintroduction firewalls all agree.
phases.qa_focus: No completion by vibes and no mostly-unified exceptions.
